_comment: Finding-policy map (ported 2026-09-02 from siamese-reconcile). Maps each REGISTERED finding code to its enforcement CLASS (blocking | advisory | off), decoupled from the check's intrinsic severity. Advisory-by-default: blocking is opt-in. Precedence off > blocking > advisory > source-default is implemented in scripts/enforcement_policy.py::resolve_class. Every code in FINDING_REGISTRY MUST appear under 'policy' here, and each is documented in .claude/rules/enforcement.md. This file is Tier-1 sacred (file_tiers.py ^\.claude/rules/.*): an agent cannot soften its own gate without SACRED_OVERRIDE_FILES authorization.
